$comment: Logical bodies for standardized V1 shared conversation actions beyond message.create/edit/delete/reaction/receipt.

PinSet.present: boolean; latest authorized state for target wins

ModerationRedact.reason: optional bounded reason code/text according to room policy

PollCreate.identity: the poll.create ConversationEvent EventID is the poll identifier
PollCreate.question: bounded RichTextV1
PollCreate.options: bounded ordered list of stable option_id + bounded label
PollCreate.max_selections: optional positive bound for multiple selection

PollVote.selected_option_ids: set/list satisfying the PollCreate selection policy

TopicCreate.topic_id: random stable TopicID local to this ConversationID
TopicCreate.title: bounded title

MessageTopicSet.topic_id: existing TopicID, or null only if room policy permits untopiced placement

ConvergenceRules: pin.set latest authorized EventClock state per target_event_id wins
moderation.redact is monotonic suppression unless a future explicit restore capability is standardized
poll.vote latest authorized EventClock state per actor_principal + target_poll_event_id wins
poll.close is monotonic; votes ordered after the accepted close do not alter the closed tally
topic field/status/message-placement conflicts resolve by authenticated authorization plus EventClock ordering
